name: tool-hammad-ai-proposal-writer-anna-84jkbu68
description: JSON-RPC tool plugin powering AI Proposal Writer with proposal generation, section regeneration, quality audit, text refinement, and LLM sampling.

tools.name: generate_proposal
tools.description: Generate a complete structured project proposal from input form data.

parameters.name: formData
parameters.description: Proposal form data containing steps 1 to 4.

tools.name: regenerate_section
tools.description: Regenerate a specific section of a proposal using AI.

parameters.name: sectionTitle
parameters.description: Title of the section to regenerate.

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: Specific user instructions for how to rewrite the section.

tools.name: audit_proposal
tools.description: Conduct a comprehensive AI Quality Assurance audit of a proposal, scoring completeness, pricing math, risk coverage, and clarity.

tools.name: refine_text
tools.description: Refine or rewrite proposal text with a specific instruction (improve tone, make concise, expand technical details, simplify, add risks).

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional context such as proposal title or client company.

tools.name: extract_brief
tools.description: Extract structured proposal fields (client, project, problem, features, budget) from unstructured client RFP or brief text.

parameters.name: briefText
parameters.description: Raw project brief, email, or RFP text.
